## Purpose

## Supported production types
Describe filmed, generative, graphic, animated, 3D, screen-captured or hybrid pathways.

## Evidence

- [ ] Real media preview / reproducible CI artifact (if renderable)

## Model boundaries

## Known limitations / reviewer concerns
List unavailable adapters, unsupported media types and unevaluated quality gates.
